messages:
maya: Hey team — need a quick approval / check. Customer reported a bad hallucination trace in staging and I want to temporarily enable full request+response capture on the staging inference proxy to reproduce. Would capture includes headers, request body (prompts), and model responses.

maya: Plan: enable for the staging cluster only, TTL 48h on the debug bucket, ACL restricted to SRE+Support on a short-lived role, and apply on-write KMS encrypt. Will NOT enable in prod.

maya: Example of the feature toggle I want to flip:```yaml
capture:
  mode: full
  store: s3://redwood-debug-staging/requests/
  retention_days: 2
  encrypt_with_kms: redwood-staging-kms
  redact_rules: [email, credit_card, ssn]
  access_role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/staging-debug-access
```

maya: Questions: (1) Is it safe to capture raw prompts (we need full prompt to repro) or should we hash or truncate them? (2) Are the redact_rules above sufficient or should we handle tokens/authorization headers specially? (3) Who should explicitly approve access to the bucket?

luca: +1 on staging-only and TTL. Do not store raw auth tokens or raw session cookies. For prompts — avoid keeping raw tokens or anything matching JWT/bearer headers.

luca: For PII in prompts: prefer deterministic hashing for user identifiers (user_id, email) before persisting. If the prompt *must* be stored verbatim to repro, limit to 48h and require a short justification ticket. Also require encrypt-at-rest (KMS) + bucket policy restricting GetObject to the approved role.

sam: Quick ops note — deploy-bot will attach an audit entry for any toggle flip, but we also need a Jira ticket linking to the justification and a list of names for the temporary role.

sam: On redact_rules: add `prompt_tokens` and `authorization` and `cookie` to be explicit. Also strip any X-Client-Token headers.

alex: From product POV — we need the full prompt for this one to reproduce. OK with staging-only, 48h TTL, access limited to SRE+Support+owner (maya). I approve provided security signs off on hashing guideline. :thumbsup:

luca: Security sign-off conditions: (a) no raw `Authorization` or session cookies persisted; (b) deterministic hash for user identifiers before write OR explicit jira justification for verbatim storage; (c) retention enforcement via lifecycle policy (2 days) and verify deletion (s3 object delete marker) before closing ticket; (d) access via STS-assumed role with MFA + short expiry (<=8h). If all met, I approve.

maya: Thanks — I'll create the Jira and include justification. Proposed access list: maya, sam, two SREs (jin, rachel), and one support engineer (oliver).

sam: Please include the exact IAM ARNs in the ticket so audit log mapping is clear.

maya: Will do. I'll also add the exact redact config we will apply:```json
{"redact_rules": ["authorization","cookie","prompt_tokens","x-client-token","email","credit_card","ssn"], "user_id_handling": "sha256", "retain_days": 2, "kms": "redwood-staging-kms"}```

deploy-bot: Deploy audit: toggle-change requested by @maya at 1962507895; review pending security approval.

luca: Two extra suggestions: (1) store only the last 2k chars of the prompt if it's huge, or capture a hash + first/last 1k chars; (2) log a redaction-fingerprint (hash of redaction-normalized prompt) to help correlate without plaintext.

maya: Good call. I'll implement the prompt truncation + fingerprint.

maya: Action items I'll do now: create jira (INC-2381), add ARNs, add justification, push config to staging toggle under a gated feature flag, run for 48h, and post deletion verification. Will ping here when done.

alex: Thanks — ping when the ticket is up and security verifies.

luca: Approved pending the jira link + ARNs + lifecycle proof.

maya: Jira created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2381 — added ARNs, justification, and config. Kicking the toggle in 10m for 48h.

sam: Noted. I'll watch the audit trail and will revoke access as soon as the window ends.

maya: Done — toggle enabled at 1962507980. I'll post deletion confirmation after TTL. :white_check_mark:
